errors.text_span: 图表包含10个灰色的柱状图，每个柱状图代表一次实验的结果。
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart containing 10 groups of 2 bars each (20 bars total). The description incorrectly states there are only 10 bars and fails to identify the grouped structure.

The description completely omits the legend and the two distinct data series it represents: '30个模型结果的均值' (Average of 30 model results) and '30个模型的投票结果' (Voting result of 30 models). This is the main comparison the chart is designed to show.

errors.text_span: 最后一个柱状图高度约为74
errors.evidence: The last two bars in the chart (for category 10) have heights of approximately 70.5 (light gray) and exactly 75 (dark gray). No bar has a height of 74.

errors.text_span: 柱状图高度近似相等，在70-75之间波动
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly lumps together two distinct data series into a single range. In reality, the light gray bars are consistently around 70.5-71, and the dark gray bars are consistently at 75. This generalization obscures the main finding of the chart, which is the consistent difference between the two series.
The description claims the vertical axis is labeled '值' (Value), but the axis has no text label, only numerical tick marks.
